question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Wax
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wane**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wax **means to increase or grow. (बढ़ना)
 
• Marked option **Wane **means to gradually decrease in size. (आकार में धीरे-धीरे कम होना)
 
• "**Wax and wane**" is a common idiomatic expression that describes the cyclic or alternating pattern of growth and decline, increase and decrease, or rise and fall of something over time. 
 
• It is often used to describe the changing nature of various phenomena, such as the moon's phases, emotions, trends, or even the fortunes of an individual or an organization.
 
 
• **For example-** *His commitment to democracy and free markets has waxed and waned with his political fortunes.*
 
 
 
• According to the meanings, it is clear that the **opposite **of 'wane' is 'wax'.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Polish**: To make something shine by rubbing it and often by putting a special cream or liquid on it. (पॉलिश से चमकाने की क्रिया)
 
• **Cane**: A stick that is used to help somebody walk. (बेंत, डंडी, छड़ी)
 
• **Wall**: A solid, vertical structure made of stone, brick, etc. that is built around an area of land to protect it or to divide it. (दीवार, दीवाल)
